fit_reason: Private owner selling a whole SUV (2013 GMC Acadia), which we can detail.
findings: Headlight lenses look slightly yellowed and hazy, most visible on the front three-quarter shots
Paint on the hood and sides looks reasonably glossy but a bit flat in spots, with what appears to be light dust and film on the lower doors
Light dirt and grime along the lower rocker panels and rear bumper area
Black lower bumper trim and window trim look slightly faded
No interior photos, so the interior can't be judged
message: Hi, we saw your listing for the Acadia and it looks well kept. The headlight lenses are starting to look a little yellow in the photos, and the lower trim and rockers could use some freshening up. We do mobile pre-sale details, including headlight restoration, and come to you. Would you like a quote?
